title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closed US hours at $63,799, down 0.3 percent, holding above key support as fear grips the tape at 27 on the index. 

Network health stays robust with hashrate at 822.8 EH/s and mempool backlog at 80,087 transactions, though fees remain low at 3 sat per vB. Block height now sits at 962,073. 

Key takeaway: price action shows resilience while sentiment stays depressed, keeping downside limited for now. 

Watch overnight for any macro headline that could trigger a move through 64,200 resist
